senses.gloss: f.(b. h. אַשְׁמֹרָה, אַשְׁמֹרֶת; שמר)night-watch, watch, a certain portion (three or four hours) of the day, called a watch (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Castra).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite> <he>סוף הא׳ וכ׳</he> the end of the first watch of the night; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="A03329"><he>אַשְׁמוֹרוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:26">Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ</cite> top <he>ארבע</he>(<cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>) <he>א׳ וכ׳</he> the day is divided into four watches, and so is the night; cmp. Bab.
